name: Kaigi Centre
description: Kaigi Centre is a conference centre WordPress theme designed for association congresses, academic symposia, and corporate offsites. Built with Fraunces serif headings, Source Sans 3 typography, and a calm plum palette, it features clear room network listings, transparent hire rates, and documentary storytelling. The layout provides a single-column longform editorial flow, detailed floor plan specifications, and structured event planning schedules. Works without WooCommerce. Fraunces for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
